instruction: Use the OPTIMADE API to query binary titanium-oxygen structures (nelements=2, elements HAS ALL "Ti","O"). Save the results to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\setup\output_result\optimade\opt_task_17.txt', one entry per line in the format 'id chemical_formula_hill'.
